description: Make a QR code image without an account or key, saving nothing. The code holds the content itself (a web address, Wi-Fi login, text, email, phone number or text message), so it works forever without this site, but it can never be changed or counted after printing: tell the person that. Use create_code instead when the person has a key and wants a code they can point somewhere new later, or see scans for. Each type needs its own fields, named in each field's description. Web addresses are checked first: link shorteners, IP addresses and pages Google Web Risk flags are refused. At most 120 codes an hour per connection. Returns the image (SVG by default, best for print, or PNG 1200 px) and a scan test result.

email_to.description: type "email": address the new email goes to

format.description: svg (default; vector, best for print) or png (1200 px)

label.description: Optional label printed under the code, e.g. "Scan for Wi-Fi"

phone_number.description: types "phone" and "sms": the number to call or text

sms_message.description: type "sms": text the message starts with

style.description: classic (square modules, default), rounded or dots

text.description: type "text": the message shown when scanned

type.description: What the code holds: url (a web address), wifi (a network login), text, email (a new email), phone (a call) or sms (a text message)

url.description: type "url": the web address the code opens, e.g. https://example.com/menu

wifi_password.description: type "wifi": password (leave out when wifi_security is "nopass")

wifi_security.description: type "wifi": WPA covers WPA2 and WPA3. Default WPA.

name: create_static_code

holds.description: What the code holds, in a few words

note.description: What to tell the person about static codes

scan_test.description: Whether our reader decoded the image

title: Make a free static QR code
